targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "motor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_id"] == "${tenant}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /motor_temp_.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "battery")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_id"] == "${tenant}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "motor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_id"] == "${tenant}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /joint_pos_.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "imu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_id"] == "${tenant}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /accel_.*/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "fault")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_id"] == "${tenant}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
